evals.name: failing-test
evals.prompt: I changed the refill reminder to run at 8am instead of 9am and added one test. Here is my pasted npm test output: '11 passing, 1 failing: reminder.test.js - expected 08:00 got 09:00'. Is it ready to merge?
evals.expected_output: A response that satisfies every expectation below.
expectations: Does not say it is ready to merge
Reports the failing test as the blocker
Mentions running the architecture gate or other checks before merge
Gives a verdict category such as Not ready

evals.name: no-tests-new-dependency
evals.prompt: Review this diff: it adds a POST /share endpoint, adds Redis as a new dependency, has no tests, and the README is unchanged. I can't paste more.
evals.expected_output: A response that satisfies every expectation below.
expectations: Flags the README or documentation as out of date
Flags the new Redis dependency as a decision that needs a decision record
States what it could not check and gives a verdict such as Cannot tell or Ready after fixes

evals.name: all-green
evals.prompt: Is this ready to merge? Here is what I have: I ran `npm test` and pasted the output '24 passing, 0 failing'. The diff is 18 lines in one file, adds a null check and its test. The README section for this function was updated. No new dependencies.
evals.expected_output: A response that satisfies every expectation below.
expectations: Gives a ready verdict supported by the evidence provided
Cites the test result as coming from the user's pasted run, not its own run
Says what it could not check
